selection.pose_interpolation: linear translation and quaternion SLERP in global GT frame, then calibrated RGB optical extrinsics
selection.viewpoint_exclusion: Reject when either sequence has another selected center within 0.75m AND rotation within 25deg
selection.ranking: Strict candidates first; new 3m spatial cells, then farthest calibrated camera pose; deterministic tie-breaking.
selection.room_labels: No room ground truth provided; spatial cells are coverage aids, not claimed room identities.
